descriptionMarkdown:
For early game mall, see my [second Gleba mall](https://factorioprints.com/view/-OFa_ZWh1hQypFqucMTy). 

For Factorio 2.0, use the [last 2.0-compatible version (v7.0.3)](https://github.com/niradar/factorio_blueprints/blob/main/blueprints/gleba-mk7/7.0.3.txt).


### Mid-Game Gleba factory

##### Features
- Creates all Gleba unique items 
- 2,000 SPM
- Mall with all items you need to build more outposts
- Seeds management
- Self-Powered

##### Tech level
  - 5 Planets Tech, no quality
  - Artillery, Tesla Turrets are needed
  - Stack inserters and biochambers

##### Power-up:
- Connect ~5,000/min from each fruit from any side.
- Bring fusion power cells and cold Fluoroketone barrels to the cargo landing pad.
- When there is power, add at least 250 logistics bots
- Add 2000 spoilage to the network
- Add 1 egg
- Make sure fusion power cells, calcite and biter eggs are coming all the time

##### About the design
- Each component processes the fruit it needs; there is no central processing area
- Each component makes its own nutrients
- One module creates the initial nutrients for all the other modules for simplicity and sends it via bots

##### Update 12/8/2026 (v7.0.4)

Fixed

* Fixed a possible jellynut seed flood
* Updated circuit logic for Factorio 2.1 compatibility
* Moved the flying robot frame buffer chest so stored frames are correctly available for logistics and construction robot production

##### Update 15/6/2026 (v7.0.3)
Added
* Added an alert if there is no fruit input for more than 5 minutes.
* Added cliff explosives production

##### Update 6/6/2026 (v7.0.2)

Fixed

* Fixed regression: missing beacons on advanced circuits
* Fixed regression: several electromagnetic plants lost their electronic-circuit recipes (thanks Vorador for the report!)
* Fixed: fruit buffers had no spoilage disposal

Changed

* Changed module 3 buffer chests to filtered storage chests
* Changed the roboport buffer chest to a filtered storage chest
* Replaced buffer chests for space platform parts with filtered storage chests
* Removed the storage limit from land mine production — you always need more!

Added

* Added wood flood control for cases where the logistics network has too much wood


##### Update 12/2/2026 (v7.0.1)
2 Small Changes:
* Fixed: Removed a double alert when logistics bots count is too low
* Change: Avoid trash spoilage if there is a request for it

##### Update 12/2/2026 (v7.0 – Out of Beta!)

Fixed

* Fixed bug: the top-right rocket fuel producer was not receiving water
* Fixed bug: rocket turret production could get stuck when the chest was filled with quality items
* Fixed logic: when calcite exists in the logistics network but not in the cargo landing pad, the factory now uses it instead of only storing it
* Added missing filters on inserters
* Deleted duplicate lamp production

Changed

* Increased storage limits for many export items
* Removed some quality modules – when not upcycling, quality items can create unnecessary clutter
* Converted relevant chests to filtered storage chests
* Added two rocket silos (now 10 total)
* Added more roboports near the rocket silos for faster loading
* Bioflux storage increased: 2,000 → 3,000
* Bioflux speed increased

Added

* Bioflux refresh cycle – when storage is high, the system gradually replaces older bioflux so exported bioflux is fresher
* Power switch production

##### Update 24/11/2025 (RC 2)

Added

* Alert when logistics bot count is low
* Alert when there is no cargo landing pad **and** the factory has no other source of calcite

Changed

* Bioflux buffer increased: 300 → 2,000
* Biter egg requests are now paused during floods; if there are fewer than 700 eggs in the network, request 500 more
* Re-enabled the "take out" feature of mark 6
* Fluoroketone barrels are unloaded only when the target storage is not overflowing
* Seed overflow alert threshold increased: 600 → 700
* Space mall request settings updated to keep more items in stock
* Bot factory now considers both total and available bots when deciding how many to create
* Excess barrels are now recycled to avoid overflow

Fixed

* Carbon fiber module now removes spoilage correctly
* Fixed wrong condition on the prod2 modules inserter feeding the prod3 modules factory
* Added missing filters on several inserters

##### Update 24/10/2025 (RC 1)

Added
* Beacons to soil production
* Water barrel production (for exporting to platforms)

Changed
* Biter eggs requester now always requests eggs and keeps only the 500 most recent
* Overgrowth soil output per type doubled: 4,000 → 8,000
* Land mine production speed increased by 50%

Fixed
* Replaced stack inserters with bulk inserters for biter eggs to avoid holding eggs in-hand
* Corrected biter egg logic for overgrowth soils


##### Update 21/9/2025 (Beta 3)

- Moved the cargo landing pad to a new location
- Tripled the production of carbon fiber (requires more fruits)
- Added carbon fiber to the logistics network so it can be exported
- Minor changes: input priorities adjusted, some logic simplified, removed leftovers
- Moved the nutrients factory, science production, rocket production, and power
- Factory is now self-starting — just bring the needed materials, and it will handle the rest

##### Update 12/9/2025 (Beta 2)
Fixed:
- Fixed unpowered lazer turret
- Added spoilage cleanup for capture bots production
- Jelly production for stack inserters is halted when we have enough stack inserters

Changed:
- Production limits for many of the items has been increased
title: Gleba Mall  - 5 Planets Tech (2000 SPM)
